prompt:
Support logins should SELECT from `dbo.Crew` but see TaxId as `XXX-XX-1234` (last four visible) and Email in the built-in email mask. They have SELECT, not UNMASK. Privileged auditors must still see plaintext.

Which statements are true of the following masks?
explanation: DDM is display-time obfuscation. SELECT is allowed; UNMASK (or high privilege) bypasses the mask. It does not encrypt data at rest or in memory for the engine/DBA — that is why question 1 needed Always Encrypted.

options.text: Support SELECT succeeds with masked values; principals with UNMASK (or dbo) see plaintext — DDM is not encryption
Support SELECT fails with permission denied until UNMASK is granted
`partial` and `email` encrypt the column with a service-managed key (Always Encrypted)
Masking applies only to backups, never to SELECT
